message.content: {"merge": false, "reason": "The two skills represent conflicting procedural logics for handling negative or ambiguous grounding results. Skill A ('Triangulate...') mandates a strict sequential verification where failure at any step (including grounding) results in a negative answer ('no'). Skill B ('Escalate...') explicitly instructs NOT to treat empty grounding as a definitive negative and instead requires escalating to an expert model to override the grounding failure. Merging these would create a logical contradiction: Skill A says 'if grounding fails, answer no', while Skill B says 'if grounding fails, ask expert'. These are incompatible control flows for the same scenario."}
